caption: A Chicago wrestler billed as a former world champion ten years out of the ring and in business, who came back for NGEN's Cherry Blossom Chaos as King Krusher's partner against Cameron Cruise and Problem Child; the fed's founder says the two won the NGEN World Tag Titles.

caption: A 6'7", 462-pound sumo heel from Wuhan, China, whose profile has Abigail Sharp discover him at sixteen and sign him to WFW:NE; one of four men in the Falls Count Anywhere on the Mall elimination match for the vacant NGEN North American Title at Cherry Blossom Chaos, which HAL won.

name: Adrian Willard

tenures.source: The fed's own forum pages (first /promotions/ngen-2010/archive/bio-for-the-prophecy-adrian-willard-2010-01-24.html and the pages after it on this fed's boards).

caption: A 24-year-old Chicago heel billed "The Prophecy," whose profile calls him a two-time NCAA champion, who made his NGEN debut at Cherry Blossom Chaos with The Freak and lost when the referee stopped Donovan Astros' Martyr's Cross.

identity.note: Same-name characters in other feds: New ERA's "The Prophecy" Adrian Willard (a card of 2011 and an Empire Pro run from 2011 to 2013) shares the name and the moniker, and this fed's profile says WFW:NE signed him; the 2011 Adrian Willard of PWC and NFW is billed young, with an NCAA background, as this fed's profile bills him. A shared name, moniker and background are not evidence of identity by themselves, so every same-name record is filed distinct, presumed, pending a verdict.

caption: A Boston wrestler billed as the son of a retired professional wrestler, who made his pro debut against Jeff Jorgenson at Cherry Blossom Chaos in one of his father's old robes; Jorgenson pulled the robe over his head as the bell rang and beat him with a superkick.
